title: The Lost Landfall
premise: Ivo Thornbury, a riverboat captain hiding from a past conviction she never deserved, is hired to resupply an archaeological expedition upriver. When the expedition goes silent, she finds them guarding a drowned city whose artifacts could clear her name—if she surrenders them to the corrupt magistrate who framed her. Torn between the love of expedition cartographer Sena Voss and her duty to the crew she's sworn to bring home alive, Ivo chooses justice outside the law: she runs the rapids at flood stage, delivers the survivors, and lets the river keep its secret, trading her exoneration for the truth.
about_author: A. M. Yarrow is the pen name of a former barge pilot who spent eleven years working inland waterways before turning to fiction. Their novels are known for river-lore authenticity and morally tangled heroes who prefer currents to courtrooms.

chapters.title: The Debt on the Dock
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Broke and hounded by creditors, Ivo accepts a lucrative contract to resupply the Halvorsen expedition upriver, though the route passes through the magistrate's jurisdiction. She loads crates she isn't allowed to inspect. Emotional beat: wary pragmatism masking dread.

chapters.title: Passengers Who Don't Talk
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Two silent men board claiming to be surveyors; their boots are wrong for survey work. Ivo logs their habits, tests them with false river gossip, and learns they're reporting to someone downstream. Beat: sharpening suspicion.

chapters.title: Sena's Maps
chapters.summary: Sena's POV. At the last fuel stop, cartographer Sena Voss joins the boat, carrying maps of a reach that officially doesn't exist. She and Ivo argue over charts, then over coffee until dawn. Beat: reluctant attraction kindling.

chapters.title: The Magistrate's Toll
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Magistrate Corven Hale boards at Kessel Bend, recognizes Ivo from her trial years ago, and offers to 'lose' her file if she reports what the expedition finds. She refuses; he smiles like a man holding a hook already set. Beat: old injustice reopened.

chapters.title: Dead Air
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The scheduled radio check from the upstream camp comes in garbled, then not at all. The two surveyors demand she turn back; Ivo instead points the bow upriver into rising water. Beat: the point of no return.

chapters.title: What the River Keeps
chapters.summary: Sena's POV. Navigating uncharted channels by moonlight, Sena reveals the expedition sought the sunken city of Aldermere, drowned by a dam scandal thirty years ago. Her brother was on the first survey team that vanished. Beat: shared secrets deepen trust.

chapters.title: The First Camp
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. They find the base camp burned, supplies intact but radios smashed—sabotage, not flood. A survivor's note names Hale. One surveyor slips away in the night with a crate. Beat: cold fear hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Aldermere Rising
chapters.summary: Sena's POV. Drought-lowered waters have exposed Aldermere's bell tower and streets. The main expedition is camped among the ruins, starving, guarding artifacts they refuse to surrender to anyone. Beat: awe shadowed by siege mentality.

chapters.title: Professor Halvorsen's Bargain
chapters.summary: Halvorsen's POV. The dying professor confesses he forged permits for Hale in exchange for funding, and that the artifacts prove the dam flooded living towns deliberately. He asks Ivo to take the evidence out—even if it means Hale hunts her forever. Beat: guilt passed like a torch.

chapters.title: The Traitor's Crate
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The missing surveyor returns with Hale's enforcers, demanding the collection. In the standoff, Sena takes a graze defending the maps. Ivo hides the crucial ledger inside her engine housing. Beat: love declared under fire.

chapters.title: Siege at the Bell Tower
chapters.summary: Sena's POV. Enforcers cut off the river exit. The besieged party fortifies the tower; Ivo scouts the flooded streets and finds her brother's name carved by the first lost team. Beat: grief braided with defiance.

chapters.title: Hale Comes Upriver
chapters.summary: Hale's POV. Aboard his gunboat, Hale reflects on the drowning he helped cover up and the captain he ruined to bury it. He orders no witnesses. Beat: villainy given a human, chilling logic.

chapters.title: The Ledger
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Reading Halversen's ledger, Ivo finds the signature that could exonerate her—and realizes Hale framed her because her father witnessed the drownings. Justice and escape finally point the same way. Beat: fury transmuted into purpose.

chapters.title: Running the Narrows
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Under cover of storm, Ivo threads the boat through the flooded narrows past the gunboat, taking on water, losing the radio mast, gaining the open river. Beat: triumphant terror.

chapters.title: The Price of the Crossing
chapters.summary: Sena's POV. The engine floods; they drift aground. One crew member drowns saving the ledger, and Ivo carries the guilt ashore. Sena binds the wound in Ivo's hands and refuses to let her carry it alone. Beat: mourning fused with intimacy.

chapters.title: Kessel Bend in Flames
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Reaching town, they find Hale has burned the expedition's warehouse and branded them pirates. The law offers no road home—only the one Ivo builds herself. Beat: betrayal at its deepest.

chapters.title: The Witness List
chapters.summary: Sena's POV. Sena decodes her brother's hidden survey notes, corroborating the ledger and naming surviving witnesses of the drownings scattered along the river. Beat: hope assembled piece by piece.

chapters.title: Gathering the Current
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo spends her last coin buying testimony from ferrymen, lockkeepers, and widows—the river's own jury. The two-faced surveyor defects, bringing proof of Hale's orders. Beat: quiet revolution.

chapters.title: The Trial on the Water
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. At the annual lock fair, Ivo stages a public reading of the ledger before hundreds of riverfolk as Hale's gunboat closes in. Beat: tension at breaking point.

chapters.title: Flood Stage
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Hale tries to arrest her mid-river; the crowd of boats blocks him. In the chaos, Hale's own enforcer testifies against him rather than drown for his secrets. Beat: cathartic climax.

chapters.title: What She Gave Up
chapters.summary: Sena's POV. Officially exonerated only partially—her record sealed, not cleared—Ivo declines the magistrate's offer to trade the artifacts' location for full pardon. Some things belong to the drowned. Beat: costly integrity.

chapters.title: Landfall
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Spring high water: Ivo and Sena pilot the repaired boat downriver, delivering survivors' letters and letting the current decide where Aldermere's story surfaces next. The compass finally points somewhere she wants to go. Beat: peace earned, journey continuing.
